title: "Relative Image Position within a Group" plot of film image positions
description: Large hand-plotted graph titled "Relative Image Position within a Group" showing clusters of small symbols (circles, diamonds, squares, triangles) marking the relative positions of individual images across successive frames, with numbered scale marks along the axes. A dark horizontal band of tape or a fold crosses the middle of the sheet, and a handwritten note and symbol legend ("Legend - Image") sit at lower left beside the label "Enclosure." The sheet carries struck-through "CONFIDENTIAL SECURITY INFORMATION" stamps in each corner.
